name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS)
name_hi: इंदिरा गांधी राष्ट्रीय दिव्यांगता पेंशन योजना
description: Social assistance pension for persons with severe and multiple disabilities below the poverty line.
benefits: Monthly financial pension assistance + medical aids

criteria.description: Applicant must be a person with benchmark disability
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant is not marked as having a disability

criteria.description: Applicant must be at least 18 years old
Applicant must belong to BPL family
criteria.disqualification_reason: Applicant does not have BPL status
